This section contains guides and team resources for common workflows and tasks.

If you are new, [Meetings](meetings.qmd) covers the group's standing meetings, [Group Workflow](group-workflow.qmd) covers the software we coordinate with, [Data Management](data-management.qmd) covers where your data should live and what is (and is not) backed up, and [GitHub and Zenodo](github-zenodo.qmd) covers how projects are structured and archived.
